Meta.title: Akçay Palet | Wooden Pallet Manufacturing
Meta.description: Akçay Palet — wooden pallet manufacturing to EUR/EPAL dimensions. Export pallets go through ISPM-15 compliant heat treatment; standard and custom sizes are produced.

Header.announcement: Work directly with the manufacturer for your wooden pallet needs.

Hero.title: The Strength That Carries Your Load.
Hero.subtitle: Reliable, made-to-order pallet solutions at industrial scale.

Transition.title: We Produce More Than Pallets.
Transition.body: From EPAL/EUR dimensions to heat-treated export production, from custom sizes to domestic-market pallets — an end-to-end solution from a single manufacturer.

Products.title: From standard to custom, one manufacturer.
Products.body: From the EUR/EPAL dimension standard to custom-size production, from heat-treated export pallets to domestic logistics solutions — we cover all your pallet needs from a single source.

rows.use: Designed for your product — see Custom Production

Custom.title: We Build to Your Dimensions.
Custom.body: Standard sizes don't fit every need. Send us the details below and we'll prepare a production plan and quote tailored to you — much faster than a traditional manufacturer.

requirements.desc: Weight and distribution of the product to be carried.

Process.title: From measurement to heat treatment, controlled production.

steps.title: Cutting & Shaping
steps.desc: We cut and shape the timber to the dimensions of your order.

steps.title: Assembly & Nailing
steps.desc: We join the boards with tolerances suited to the load.

steps.title: Heat Treatment & Inspection
steps.desc: Export pallets receive ISPM-15 compliant heat treatment and dimensional checks.

pillars.title: Technical Sizing Support
pillars.desc: We work with you to determine the right pallet size for your product's transport needs.

pillars.title: Flexible Production
pillars.desc: Alongside standard sizes, we plan production in dimensions specific to your product.

pillars.title: Direct Communication
pillars.desc: Throughout quoting and production, you speak directly with the manufacturing team.

Final.body: From standard sizes to custom production. Let's turn your needs into production.

Footer.disclaimer: Prices may vary by order quantity, dimensions and delivery region. Our heat-treated pallets are produced through an ISPM-15 compliant process. Images are illustrative.

ProductsPage.title: Our wooden pallet range.
ProductsPage.body: Standard pallets in EUR/EPAL dimensions, ISPM-15 compliant export pallets, domestic-market pallets and custom-size production — with dimensions, heat treatment and use cases.
ProductsPage.metaDescription: 80×120, 80×100 and 100×120 cm wooden pallets, ISPM-15 compliant export pallets, domestic pallets and custom-size production.

Workshop.metaTitle: Pallet Workshop: Design Your Pallet | Akçay Palet
Workshop.metaDescription: Design your wooden pallet to size: 3D view, technical drawing, bill of materials and load estimate. Send your design and we'll prepare a tailored quote.
Workshop.title: Design your pallet, get your quote.
Workshop.body: Choose the dimensions, board count and wood species, and your pallet appears instantly in 3D with its technical drawing and bill of materials. Send the design in one click and our sales team will get back to you.
Workshop.blockNote: On a block pallet the 3 bottom boards line up with the rows of blocks.
Workshop.no3d: The 3D view isn't available on this device; showing the technical drawing.
Workshop.loadNote: Load values are a rough estimate based on top-deck bending; our technical team confirms them before production.

warnings.topNoFit: The top boards don't fit the pallet size. Reduce the number or width of boards.
warnings.topGapWide: Top deck gap is {gap} mm. Under 75 mm is recommended for small cartons.
warnings.bottomNoFit: The bottom boards don't fit the pallet length.
warnings.blocksTouch: The blocks touch each other; reduce the block size.
warnings.blockLow: Block height is under 70 mm: pallet truck forks may not fit.
warnings.stringerLow: Stringer height is under 75 mm: forklift entry becomes difficult.
warnings.thinTop: A top deck under 16 mm is only for light, one-way loads.
warnings.noIspm: Export shipments usually require the ISPM-15 heat treatment stamp.

Workshop.quoteNote: Pricing is prepared for you based on quantity, wood species and delivery location. Send your request and our sales team will call you.
